summary: @onereach/billing-dto ships install-time dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that at install time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via execFileSync to run a shipped sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated bun-cjs bundle using rotated string-array/`_0xNNNN` obfuscator.io-style transforms. setup.mjs itself is also obfuscated with `_0xNNNN` identifiers and inline lookup-object indirection hiding execFileSync, https.get, and filesystem writes. The package is advertised as a billing DTO library (dist/index.js exports only enums/type helpers) and has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate language runtime at install time or execute a large opaque bundle. The alternate-runtime execution evades Node-based static analysis of the installed package, and the payload's behavior is deliberately hidden from the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
